shell.footer_note: Regnovum — your account in simple, accessible pages.

field.email_hint: We use this address to confirm the account and to tell you when it changes.
field.code_hint: Paste the code we sent by email.
field.account_key_hint: Your 32-character secret key generated during registration.
field.username_hint: Choose your public username on Regnovum (3 to 30 characters).

verify_success.heading: Email verified successfully
verify_success.detail: Your Regnovum account is active and your email address is confirmed.
verify_success.note: You can sign in with your credentials now.

verify_error.heading: Verification link invalid or expired
verify_error.detail: Your email could not be confirmed. The link may have expired or been used already.
verify_error.note: Request a new confirmation link or contact support.

reset_form.heading: Password reset
reset_form.detail: Enter your new password to recover access to your account.

reset_success.heading: Password reset successfully
reset_success.detail: Your password was updated and every previous session was revoked for your safety.
reset_success.note: You can sign in with your new credential now.

reset_error.heading: Your password could not be reset
reset_error.detail: The recovery token is invalid, expired or was used before.
reset_error.note: Request a new password recovery to continue.

errors.weak_password: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
errors.invalid_code: The code is invalid, expired or already used.
errors.csrf_title: The page is no longer valid
errors.csrf_detail: The form protection expired. Reload the page and submit it again.

register.heading: Create account
register.intro: Create your account to take part in the Arenas. Choose a username to generate your access key.
register.legacy_heading: Or create with email and password
register.notice_detail: If this address does not already have a confirmed account, we sent a verification code. Use the code on the confirmation page.
register.key_notice_detail: Store this key in a secure location. It is your only credential to access Regnovum. We do not require an email or phone, and the key cannot be recovered if lost.
register.key_warning: Warning: Save this key now. We do not use email or phone for recovery: anyone with this key has access to the account. If you lose it, access cannot be recovered.

verify.heading: Confirm email
verify.intro: Enter the code we sent to your email to activate the account.
verify.success_detail: Your account is active and you can sign in.

login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: Use your account access key or sign in with email and password.
login.legacy_heading: Or sign in with email and password

logout.heading: End session
logout.intro: Ending the session in this browser ends the access until you sign in again.

reset.heading: Recover access
reset.intro: Enter the email of your account to receive a recovery code.
reset.notice_detail: If an account exists for this address, we sent a recovery code. Use the code to set a new password.
reset.confirm_intro: Enter the recovery code and the new password. Every older session will be ended.
reset.confirm_success_detail: Your password was changed and every older session was ended.

account.private_intro: What the server keeps about you on this account.
account.reputation_intro: Verified counts, no score and no ranking.
account.unknown_user: This profile does not exist or is not published yet.

sessions.heading: Your sessions
sessions.intro: The browsers with access to this account. End any you do not recognize.
sessions.revoke_confirm: End the session {id}? This cannot be undone.
sessions.revoked_current: You ended this browser's session. Sign in again to continue.

mfa.heading: Second factor
mfa.intro: The second factor guards this account's sensitive gestures. The secret and the codes appear exactly once: keep them now.
mfa.begin_note: We generate a pending secret for this account only. It appears exactly once and is never shown again.
mfa.uri_note: Keep this authenticator setup address too; it appears exactly once.
mfa.code_hint: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
mfa.backup_note: Keep these codes now: each is worth exactly once, and this is the only time they appear.
mfa.stepup_note: Elevates only this browser's session for the sensitive gesture. It grants no role and frees no other account.
mfa.recover_note: The path of whoever lost the authenticator: a code spent here is worth exactly once and is recorded.
mfa.elevated_stepup: Session elevated. Proceed with the sensitive gesture.
mfa.elevated_recovery: Session elevated by the recovery code. Generate new codes when you can.
mfa.failure_invalid: That code does not check out. Try the current code.
mfa.failure_replayed: That code was already used. A spent code is never worth again: enter the current one.
mfa.failure_missing: No pending enrollment. Start the enrollment before confirming.
mfa.failure_enrolled: This account already has a confirmed second factor. Enrollment never replaces a working factor.
mfa.failure_not_enrolled: This account has no confirmed second factor.
mfa.failure_step_required: The elevation lapsed. Elevate again to continue.
mfa.failure_generic: The second factor did not answer. Try again with a fresh code.

exports.heading: Export my data
exports.intro: Request a file with your data and download it when it is ready. The download link is worth exactly once.
exports.stepup_note: The request needs a recent authentication: if the session went stale, sign in again before requesting.
exports.pending_note: The file is being generated. Ask again to meet the active request; there is no other status address.
exports.ready_note: Download now: the link is worth exactly once and expires in 24 hours.
exports.revoke_note: After saving, the temporary file address is revoked and nothing stays in the browser.
exports.failure_stale: The session went stale for this request. Sign in again and ask once more.
exports.failure_gone: This link is worth no more: used, expired, or of another account. Request a new export.
exports.failure_forged: This receipt does not check out. Download only through the request you made.
exports.failure_generic: The export did not answer. Try again.

deletion.heading: Delete my account
deletion.intro: The deletion request is yours, of your privacy: it opens 7 days of cooling off, and only counts after your explicit confirmation.
deletion.cooling: 7 days of cooling off: you can cancel at any moment inside the window.
deletion.removed: At the end of the wait, the private rows leave (profile, username history, credentials, tokens, sessions).
deletion.placeholder: The account keeps only the stable identifier with an opaque email and never authenticates again.
deletion.preserved: Billing, ledger, passes, moderation and audit stay, under their retention obligations.
deletion.public_intact: Public content stays intact, with an unresolvable author.
deletion.not_sanction: This is not a sanction nor an Inquisition: it erases no obligations and touches no right of appeal.
deletion.confirm: I confirm I read the consequences above and want to open the 7 days of cooling off.
deletion.status_requested: Deletion requested: the account falls in 7 days, unless canceled.
deletion.status_canceled: Deletion canceled: the account keeps standing.
deletion.status_executed: Deletion executed: this account no longer authenticates.
deletion.cancel_note: Canceling counts inside the window; once executed or already canceled, there is nothing to cancel.
deletion.failure_missing: No request of yours. Request the deletion before reading or canceling.
deletion.failure_terminal: This request already ended: executed or canceled never comes back.
deletion.failure_ineligible: This account cannot request deletion through this path.
deletion.failure_generic: The deletion did not answer. Try again.
